title: Wildfire Emergency Transmission-Line UAV Patrol
description:
Wildfire Emergency Transmission-Line UAV Patrol
In 2025, our VTOL fixed-wing UAV power-business team successfully undertook a State Grid inspection task covering transmission corridors in 13 regions, including Hunan, Shandong, Shanxi, Hebei, and Anhui. The team carried out daily routine patrol operations and completed tens of thousands of kilometers of transmission-line inspection work with high quality, meeting the phased inspection targets.
To improve inspection efficiency and accuracy, core information such as flight routes and key tower attention points was overlaid onto the video inspection feed in real time. This made inspection tracks intuitive, presented basic tower information clearly, helped staff quickly locate faults and hidden risks, and provided visual progress awareness for efficient task completion.
